licence: Not settled: the EIA's pages give Refinitiv, an LSEG business, as the source of these spot prices, and no page read states whether they may be redistributed. Read on 25 November 2026: (1) the table page of the petroleum spot prices (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/pet_pri_spt_s1_d.htm), opened in a browser, which reads under the table "Source: Refinitiv" and "Updates occur daily"; (2) the definitions page of the natural gas spot and futures prices (https://www.eia.gov/dnav/ng/TblDefs/ng_pri_fut_tbldef2.asp), which gives under "Sources": "Spot Price: Refinitiv, an LSEG business."; (3) EIA's "Copyrights and Reuse" page (https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php), which says "U.S. government publications are in the public domain and are not subject to copyright protection." (EIA's sentence on its own publications, not a statement about these prices) and "You may use and/or distribute any of our data, files, databases, reports, graphs, charts, and other information products that are on our website or that you receive through our email distribution service.", and which speaks of "information resources contributed or licensed by private individuals, companies, or organizations that may be protected by U.S. and foreign copyright laws" and says "Transmission or reproduction of protected items beyond that allowed by fair use as defined in the copyright laws requires the written permission of the copyright owners."; (4) EIA's open-data page (https://www.eia.gov/opendata/): "EIA data is provided free of charge and should be used in compliance with our Copyrights and Reuse Policy.", and its API terms (https://www.eia.gov/opendata/terms-of-service.php) name no third party. Of the eight spot files the atlas downloads (sheet "Contents"), one gives "Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration" and seven leave the source cell empty. No page read says whether the prices credited to Refinitiv are among "our data", which may be used and distributed, or among the "protected items", which need the written permission of the copyright owners. The atlas shows these prices with this credit; the values are served to draw the charts and no download of them is offered (terms to be confirmed)
